==================================================================
Template argument with `>=` relational expression
==================================================================

template<typename Op, typename... Ts, typename = std::enable_if_t<sizeof...(Ts) >= 1>>
struct D {};

template<int N> struct W {};
W<3 >= 2> w1;
template<typename T, T v> struct IC {};
IC<int, sizeof(int) >= 4> ic;
W<3> w2 = 4 > w1;

---

(translation_unit

          (namespace_identifier)
          (template_type
            (type_identifier)
            (template_argument_list
              (binary_expression
                (sizeof_expression
                  (identifier))
                (number_literal)))))))
    (struct_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (field_declaration_list)))
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (parameter_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (identifier)))
    (struct_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (field_declaration_list)))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (binary_expression
          (number_literal)
          (number_literal))))
    (identifier))

==================================================================
Adjacent `>=` vs spaced `> =` in template position
==================================================================

template<int N> struct W {};
W<3>= 2> a;
W<3> b = c;

---

(translation_unit
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (parameter_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (identifier)))
    (struct_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (field_declaration_list)))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (binary_expression
          (number_literal)
          (number_literal))))
    (identifier))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (number_literal)))
    (init_declarator
      (identifier)
      (identifier))))

==================================================================
Relational template argument continuations keep C++ grouping
==================================================================

template<bool B> struct WB {};
WB<3 >= 2 && 0> w_and;
WB<a >= b + c> w_add;
WB<a >= b ? x : y> w_cond;
WB<3 >= 2 || f() == g> w_mix;

---

(translation_unit
  (template_declaration
    (template_parameter_list
      (parameter_declaration
        (primitive_type)
        (identifier)))
    (struct_specifier
      (type_identifier)
      (field_declaration_list)))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (binary_expression
          (binary_expression
            (number_literal)
            (number_literal))
          (number_literal))))
    (identifier))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (binary_expression
          (identifier)
          (binary_expression
            (identifier)
            (identifier)))))
    (identifier))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (conditional_expression
          (binary_expression
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (identifier)
          (identifier))))
    (identifier))
  (declaration
    (template_type
      (type_identifier)
      (template_argument_list
        (binary_expression
          (binary_expression
            (number_literal)
            (number_literal))
          (binary_expression
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list))
            (identifier)))))
    (identifier)))
